segments.he: אֶלָּא בְּעַמּוֹנִי שֶׁנָּשָׂא מִצְרִית, וְאִי זָכָר הָוֵי – הַאי שִׁדְיֵהּ אַבָּתְרֵיהּ דִּידֵיהּ, וְאִם נְקֵבָה הָוְיָא – שִׁדְיַהּ אַבָּתְרַהּ דִּידַהּ.
segments.en: «Rather,» it must be referring «to an Ammonite man who married an Egyptian woman, and» in that case «if» the child «is a male, cast him after» his father, and render him permanently prohibited from entering the congregation as an Ammonite male. «And if» the child born to them «is a female, cast her after» the mother, so that she is considered a second-generation Egyptian, who may not marry a Jew of unflawed lineage.

moves.summary: It refers to an Ammonite man and an Egyptian woman; each child follows the flawed parent of its sex
moves.about: the case is an Ammonite man who married an Egyptian woman: a son follows the father, a daughter the mother

positions.claim: a son follows the Ammonite father (permanently barred); a daughter follows the Egyptian mother (second generation)
